notes.title: Removing this game from store!
notes.content: For some reason, this game will soon be removed from the store, we don't want to clog the platform with bad games and terrible quality. Releasing this game, we made a mistake. We no longer want to make such mistakes. We respect you and Steam store.("The removal process is not fast, it may take up to 90 days, it does not depend on us") Sorry for the inconvenience and thank you for understanding!
